descriptions.w3d_d17e_load_entries_8023ee88: Reads the record's id and value arrays and appends one twelve-byte base entry (vtable 0x80410500) per index to the service object's vector at +28, growing it STLport-style when full.
descriptions.w3d_d17e_load_named_entries_8023f128: Reads the record's id, value and shared-string arrays and appends one sixteen-byte named entry (vtable 0x804104e0, string assigned with reference counting) per index to the service object's vector at +60, growing it STLport-style when full and destroying the temporary entry's string.
